description: This file defines a PHP trait AwsClientTrait that provides generic methods for interacting with Amazon Web Services (AWS). It includes methods for paginating results, iterating over resources, waiting on resources, executing commands asynchronously and synchronously, and dynamic method handling via __call.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for the specified operation name with optional arguments.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the results of a specified operation, handling pagination and result key extraction.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a specified resource reaches a desired state, using the configured waiter.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a waiter object for a specific operation with given arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously, waiting for the result.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, resolving method names, and executing commands asynchronously or synchronously based on naming conventions.
